question: The Indian Railways on October 7, 2021, launched and operated two long-haul freight trains named _______, to provide a very effective solution to the problem of capacity constraints in critical rail sections.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Trishul and Garuda **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Indian Railways:-**

 
 
• Indian Railways is one of the world's largest railway networks, covering extensive routes across India.
 
• The network is divided into zones and divisions for efficient management and operations.
 
• The first passenger train ran in 1853 between Bombay (now Mumbai) and Thane, marking the beginning of Indian Railways.
 
• Indian Railways offers various types of trains including express, passenger, local, luxury, and freight trains.
 
• Indian Railways has embraced technology with online booking, GPS tracking, and station modernization.
 
• **The Indian Railways on October 7, 2021, launched and operated two long-haul freight trains named Trishul and Garuda, to provide a very effective solution to the problem of capacity constraints in critical rail sections. **
